verdict.rationale: The pack lists Datadog docs pages titled Dashboards, Monitors and API Reference, but none of their content says dashboards or monitors can be defined as JSON, managed through Terraform, or created through the API and provisioned repeatably. A generic API reference title is not affirmative evidence of dashboards-as-code, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence. Confidence is low because the docs are listed by title only and may cover this.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define dashboards and alerts as code (JSON models, Terraform, or API) and provision them repeatably
